design: Root paired-return supervision of a two-parameter linear residual on the frozen original neural critic, applied to each simulated leaf after the original forward. No third-party programs, no independent tuning on the four withheld physical maps, no actor changes, no new game dispatched by this study. The primary estimand is pairwise terminal value on one sampled continuation per arm. Do not infer universal strategy strength.
sources: Use exactly the 12 old physical maps in the locked action_rank_data/protocol.json manifest: eight training maps then four held maps, one predetermined candidate seat and step 279 or 285 each, natural original root opponent movement shared across both arms. Both actual actions must be distinct, selected by the parent V2 native score as its top and runner-up at common depth exactly 8 using the complete identical set of rollout indices. One independent observation per physical terrain. No alternate roots, maps, or changes of seat when one fails. All 12 statuses, ties, disagreements, missing receipts and unusable reasons remain reported.
feature: Use the actual scoring leaves of each candidate, legal simulated roster (both seats), five scalars and quantized 54-plane encoded estimate bound to source root and candidate/roll; opponent hidden carbon truth, actual future actions and terminal outcome never enter the predictor. Start with frozen native scalar value v, no intercept. R=299-leaf_step, d=shortest 15x15 toroidal Manhattan distance to nearest own base. For each player's positive-cargo collectors, lost=sum cargo [d>R or R<=0]; transit=sum cargo*(d/R) over 0<=d<=R,R>0. Features x1=(lost_other - lost_us)/3000, x2=(transit_other - transit_us)/3000. This proxies delivery time and inventory exposure; no claim that reachable cargo is realized. Exact terminal leaves keep their authoritative value for every arm and have zero residual. Each final nonterminal row evaluates v+w1*x1+w2*x2. Mean equally across the original matching roll indices, subtract runner-up from first. Do not train on independent unit actions.
train: One bounded ridge fit, 2 signed coefficients (each in [-1,1]), no bias, no standardized/normalised-to-hold inputs. Minimise mean across eligible distinct training maps of (D_native+DeltaX*w-D_target)^2 + 0.01*sum(w^2). Target uses actual official margin from candidate seat for each arm separately: terminal(m)=clip(m/3000,-2.5,2.5)+0.5*sign(m), D_target=terminal(first)-terminal(second). Preserve true zero/ties. Fit with at least 6 of 8 eligible maps, >=3 maps with any nonzero DeltaX (abs>1e-7), and at least two maps with nonzero nonlinear Delta_target. Otherwise archive and stop. One ablation fits only x1 with identical shrinkage on the same maps; primary remains the two-feature model and a zero x1 column is reported. All weights freeze as float32; compare double-precision objective for diagnostics. No retuning if plateau, rank deficiency, chance continuation, or failure.
comparators: Unchanged frozen mean original leaf value (equivalently w=(0,0)), trained full two-coefficient residual, trained single-feature ablation, and direct signed present-cash baseline (average of original terminal(3000*scalar[0]) at each arm's sampled leaves; exact terminal values retained). Compute differences, winner/runner-up predicted and actual on each physical map; exact predicted tie selects incumbent's first option. Report ties and sign mistakes separately. Positive D means first better.
checks: Frozen-weight evaluation on all eligible held maps with 4/4 eligible required to consider results favorable. versus unchanged original, require (1) strict lower primary equal-map MSE in terminal-difference units, (2) >=1 original misranking corrected and zero genuine newly wrong ranks, (3) strictly positive mean realized selected-action change in both registered native-terminal units and raw official-margin points across all four maps (unchanged action contributes 0), (4) alternative actually selected >=1 held map. Ties do not count as fixes/harm; shortages or ambiguity remain indeterminate. Report raw unclipped official per-arm margins, pair margin difference, per-arm win/draw/loss, wins changed by selection, and every clip saturation (|margin|>=7500), constant-target plateau and discontinuity if sign changes; do not change target after measuring. Report row-level/paired errors, MAE, native and full ranks, sign/ties, effects per terrain, training and all comparators. No inference from only four maps to worldwide win rate, conditional expected values, or ladder readiness.
blinding: Fit reads only the eight designated training arm labels. All 12 pairs may be pre-scored prior to fit; 4 hold labels remain unread by trainer until weights, predictors and predicted choices are frozen. Record wall-clock hash publication, first available branch result, and if labels already on disk before prediction freeze denote historical blind holdout. A post-result choice never qualifies as prospective evidence.
